facts.text: John mentioned having a career-high in assists during a basketball game against their rival on Friday.

evidence.quote: I had a career-high in assists last Friday in our big game against our rival.
It felt great being out there, making plays for my team.

facts.text: John described the atmosphere in the arena during the game as electric and noted the added intensity from playing against their rivals.

evidence.quote: The atmosphere in the arena was really electric and playing against our rivals added an extra level of intensity.

facts.text: Tim expressed admiration for John's performance and asked if there were any other games as thrilling as the one against their rival.

evidence.quote: Congrats! That's awesome. How did it feel being out there making those plays?
